interpretation.boundary: The census identifies a frozen-payload opportunity upper bound. Handoff and partial-close bypasses are not yet RTL, VCS, DC, STA, power, or matched-baseline evidence.
interpretation.term_1: Of 1,894,244 two-window stage-0 tokens, 1,694,275 have an already closed successor on the release edge and are directly recoverable by M210's pre-edge-closed handoff mux.
interpretation.term_2: 199,969 three-descriptor tokens reach the first-window release before their second partial window is done-closed, so M210's current closed-window predicate cannot prefetch them.
interpretation.term_3: The 372,289 one-descriptor tokens have one partial window and no replay interval in which to hide upstream-done close/load.
